build_BiSeNetV2_backbone: build a BiSeNetV2 backbone model for real-time semantic segmentation with detail and semantic branches
create_DetailBranch: create a DetailBranch module with wide channels and shallow layers to capture low-level image details
create_SemanticBranch: create a SemanticBranch module with narrow channels and deep layers to obtain high-level semantic context
create_BGALayer: create a Bilateral Guided Aggregation Layer to fuse complementary information from detail and semantic branches
create_GELayer: create a Gather-and-Expansion Layer with configurable expansion ratio for the semantic branch stages
